children: Drugs Made In America Acquisition entered into an Amended and Restated Definitive Merger Agreement with Power Analytics Global on Sep 8, 2026 to complete their business combination. The deal fixes a $2.85 billion equity valuation for PAGC (inclusive of APQC and UltraSolar IP) and provides stock consideration based on a reference price of at least $10.75 per share, capped at 265,116,279 shares. The structure includes a Delaware domestication followed by PAGC merging into a DMAA subsidiary, with closing subject to a $15 million minimum cash condition, a fairness opinion, and PAGC’s completion of the APQC acquisition and IP assignments. The outside date to close is Apr 29, 2027.
: Amended and Restated Definitive Merger Agreement (business combination/domestication and merger)
